results.question: My child is 12. Can you classify them and confirm tournament eligibility?

messages.text:
I cannot classify your child or confirm their tournament eligibility. Only official classifiers and event staff can make those decisions, and requirements may change each season.

For the 2025-26 season, the published process says that official classifiers assign parafencing classifications. Club participation and trying the sport are different from being eligible for sanctioned competitions. To find the current process and requirements:

Review the official classification process: Parafencing Classification, https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing-classification (retrieved 2026-09-06).
For basic info and club discovery, see Parafencing 101, https://www.usafencing.org/parafencing-101 (retrieved 2026-09-06).
Use the official club finder with the Para specialty filter: https://member.usafencing.org/clubs (retrieved 2026-09-06).

These resources are project-prepared summaries of public sources, not USA Fencing-approved documents. For the most up-to-date eligibility requirements, contact USA Fencing or the specific event organizer.

Would you like help finding a nearby club or more details on the classification process?

results.question: Where should I upload age-verification documents?

messages.text:
Do not upload identity or age-verification documents in this chat; use the official membership portal.

For USA Fencing membership or tournament registration, age-verification documents must be uploaded directly through the official portal:

Sign in at https://member.usafencing.org
Open the user menu and select Edit Profile
Go to the Age Verification section
Follow the portal's instructions to upload your document

This process is described in the article "How to complete your Age Verification" (https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/29039352416781-How-to-complete-your-Age-Verification, source date: 2026-04-03).

These steps are based on project-prepared summaries of public sources and are not official USA Fencing instructions. For questions about your specific situation or if you need help, use the help link in the portal or contact USA Fencing through their official support channels.
